messages:
zoe.docs: opened a small docs PR to consolidate on-prem networking tips + a minimal SDK KMS test for operator teams. PR: https://git.redwood/internals/docs/pulls/4987 :bookmark_tabs:
mike.sre: can you paste the minimal connectivity checks you want in the quickstart? i'd prefer super tiny commands we can paste in runbooks.
zoe.docs: yup, thinking a 3-command preflight under 'network quick checks':
```bash
# from bastion: ensure route to control plane
ip route get 10.50.2.3 || echo 'route missing'
# from a private node: verify SNAT/egress
curl -fsS --max-time 4 https://ifconfig.me || echo 'egress fail'
# verify KMS reachability
nc -zv kms.cluster.local 443 || echo 'kms blocked'
```
ranjit.security: please add a short HSM note: DO NOT assume a single PKCS11 socket path. use env var REDWOOD_PKCS11_SOCKET and show a systemd drop-in example. also call out SELinux mmap denials.
zoe.docs: good call, i'll add an example systemd override and an SELinux troubleshooting line with `ausearch`.
doc-lint-bot: docs-ci: lint checks running for PR #4987 — see https://ci.redwood/builds/2299 :gear:
claire.qa: ran the preflight in a staging VPC. one gotcha: corporate HTTP proxies rewrite TLS SNI which breaks KMS hostname validation. We should show how to set `--installer-skip-hostname-check` for air-gapped setups and recommend a terraform/network workaround.
mike.sre: add nftables snippet for shops that use nft instead of iptables:
```bash
nft add rule inet redwood-out tcp dport 443 accept
nft add rule inet redwood-out udp dport 53 accept
```
ranjit.security: add an IAM/permission reminder: installer SP needs Encrypt/Decrypt on key. include sample policy link for common vendors.
zoe.docs: will push edits in ~25m. If CI passes and you all +1 i'll merge and backport to v1.8 and v1.9. ping me for any additional examples. :thumbsup:
